newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Anhyp sees return to profit.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Anhyp sees return to profit.

text.p: Anhyp, a small Belgian mortgage and savings bank, said on Monday it expected a return to profit this year.
"The dark clouds have largely disappeared," chief executive officer Carl Holsters told the annual shareholders meeting.
He added that the bank was hoping for a one billion franc non-consolidated profit, which would reverse a 467 million franc 1996 loss.
Anhyp, which has been plagued by bad property loans and a dispute with Belgian tax authorities, gave no details about its search for a possible alliance or merger with another bank.
